title: Scalable Push Notification System
question: Design a push notification system capable of sending millions of notifications daily across iOS, Android, SMS, and Email. How would you structure this system?

rubric.name: requirements_scope
rubric.description: Clarifies notification channels, latency guarantees, rate limiting, and user preference management.

rubric.name: architecture_decoupling
rubric.description: Uses message queues (e.g. RabbitMQ/Kafka) to decouple notification triggers from third-party delivery providers (APNS, FCM, Twilio, SendGrid).

rubric.name: data_user_settings
rubric.description: Designs schema for user devices, channel tokens, opt-out preferences, and template management.

rubric.name: reliability_deduplication
rubric.description: Implements idempotent notification sending, dead-letter queues (DLQ), and exponential backoff retries.

rubric.name: observability_operations
rubric.description: Tracks delivery success rate, queue lag, provider errors, and opt-out analytics.

expected_signals: Uses asynchronous message queues to prevent web request blocking
Addresses third-party provider failure with retries, exponential backoff, and dead-letter queues
Ensures idempotence via message IDs to prevent duplicate user notifications
red_flags: Makes synchronous HTTP calls to third-party providers (APNS/FCM) directly in API request handler
Lacks mechanism to handle user unsubscribe or rate limiting
Fails to address duplicate notification prevention
follow_up_prompts: How would you ensure that a user does not receive the same push notification twice if the network drops right after APNS receives it?
How would you handle priority routing when critical security alerts compete with marketing emails?
